rule: 01-research-protocol.md section 10, Phase 5 addendum items 2-3. A tool is in if it is used to make mods or games AND it is in the starting list or named in >= 3 coded Phase 2-4 records. One URL per slot; null = no known URL. Every tool has one logged site: lookup (a5-l*, phase5-queries.json); its pick fills a null slot, or replaces a config URL that is not found or still blocked after two retry rounds. An empty slot is recorded as no page found.

slotMeaning.docs: official getting-started page or first mod / first game tutorial
slotMeaning.pricing: pricing, licence or EULA page covering cost and rights to the output

mentionCount.method: case-insensitive tool-name match over coded rows of data/derived/02-public-web/deep-sample-coding.csv, 03-audience/deep-sample-coding.csv and 04-competitors/sentiment-coding.csv, counted once per recordId, 2026-10-03
mentionCount.result: No tool outside the starting list reaches 3 records. Minecraft modding 4 records (covered by the fabric-forge entry); Roblox 2; Unreal, Godot, GameMaker, Blender, Ren'Py and Scratch 1 each (one Scratch hit is the phrase 'from scratch'); one record mentions an unnamed paid AI mod tool.

aiDiscovery.rule: Collector C1 takes the first two results, in rank order, whose page is the own site of an AI-assisted game or mod creation product (host belongs to the product; not an article, list, store, video, forum or social page). Each pick is logged with its rank and reason. For each pick one site: lookup (a5-l16, a5-l17) is appended to phase5-queries.json before it runs, and the tool is added below with category ai-assisted and null slots. Fewer than two qualifying results is logged, not replaced.
